research_note: A DISTRICT DRAFT (T-3068, the owner's district pass of 2026-10-08): a serviceable first model, complete from the street, the walks, the alley and the air, that T-1946 refines in place under this same id. Written by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py from the sheet 20w trace (s20wfp-indiana_1619-b1), the T-3019 census (s20w-1619-front) and the T-1837 register row frontage-20w-1619 (Brick dwelling); every height, roof, opening and feature is the draft rules' reconstruction (data/components/prairie_1904/draft_prairie_1904.json; liberty L-draft-indiana-1904-lots-3068).

documented_range.note: The draft claims the 1904 target and no more: the 1911 sheet draws the building and the T-3019 census rules it present in 1904 (present_as_mapped). Its building and loss dates are the per-building ticket's to read.

draft_elevation.note: RECONSTRUCTED by the draft rules, family row '(default)' overlaid with the frontage row: A background house with no named record: the brick family's hip over the sheet's printed storeys, every face closed, nothing read beyond the sheet. 2½B with canted front corners, a 1B brick rear piece and a one-storey frame piece behind; the corners and the frame piece are the refining ticket's. Carried to 1904 on T-3068's reading of the Dudley household, at 1619 from 1888 to 1908. Heights are the rules' starting values inside RECONSTRUCTION-RULES.md's ranges; bays, entrance side, chimneys and dormers are counts the family rules choose, and the seed 2463920871 only tints the fabric inside +-6 %.
